observations: Stainless steel standing cooker with four hob positions.
Top-left hob appears to be an electric hotplate; the other three are gas burners.
Five white control knobs on the front panel.
Oven compartment visible with wire racks; door open in photos 0 and 2, closed in photo 1.
Watermark "POSTED ON JIJI HITHE TECHNOLOGIES" across the center of all photos.
No readable brand or model name on the appliance in any photo.

risks.risk: Electric hotplate (if fitted) may not heat.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used standing gas cooker; unproven working claims do not prevent pricing at the worst case of non-working.
